title: Board control of internship credit for school programs
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 8.01(12) Massachusetts approved colleges and schools of pharmacy shall submit to the Board a written description of each demonstration project or clinical pharmacy program for which pharmacy internship credit is desired, and the Board may determine whether student participation in such projects or programs may be credited to the internship requirement. Under 247 CMR 8.01(13) the Board issues a Summary of Objectives and Procedures for Pharmacy Internship and guidelines for registered pharmacist preceptors and pharmacy interns.
exam_relevance: Tests that internship credit for a school program is a Board determination on a submitted description rather than a school decision.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: The school proposes; the Board determines whether the program counts.
This is separate from the out-of-state experience credit route.
verification_notes: Read verbatim in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 8.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-B authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
